query: Randall Cunningham II was a multi-sport athlete at the high school located in what Nevada city?

pipeline_result.response: Randall Cunningham II was a collegiate high jumper for the USC Trojans Men's track & field team who will be a senior during the 2017–18 school year.
retrieved_context: Bishop Gorman High School: Bishop Gorman High School (also commonly referred to as Gorman High School or BGHS) is a Roman Catholic, private, preparatory school located in Summerlin, Nevada.  The school is administered by the Diocese of Las Vegas, and has been serving Clark County and the Las Vegas Valley for over 50 years.  The school opened in 1954 and its mascot is a Gael, or mounted Irish Knight.

Randall Cunningham II: Randall Cunningham II, sometimes Randall Cunningham, Jr., (born January 4, 1996) is an American collegiate high jumper for the USC Trojans Men's track & field team who will be a senior during the 2017–18 school year.  He was a high jumper and quarterback at Bishop Gorman High School.  He is a five-time Nevada Interscholastic Activities Association (NIAA) state champion (three times in track and twice in football).  He is a NCAA Outdoor Track Champion and 2-time All-American, U.S. Junior National Champion and Pan American Junior Athletics Championships Champion.
